row.Drying: dried in an oven or vacuum oven at 100 – 120˚C for 4 – 8 hours if the material absorbs more than 500ppm moisture
row.H2C left: Verify exact grade/nozzle; no blanket approval
row.H2C right: Verify exact grade/nozzle; no blanket approval
row.Locator: p. 2: RECOMMENDED FDM PRINT SETTINGS and Material Handling and Drying

notes.Text: Print Speed 30 – 60 mm/s; First Layer Speed 15 – 30 mm/s
Bed Adhesion Method Magigoo PA or PVA glue
Keep the material in the vacuum sealed packaging until ready to print; feed the filament from a dry container and store it in a dry cabinet; the drying oven has a low dew point (below -40˚C)
